Privacy Policy & Order Terms

Privacy: Customer names, phone numbers, addresses and order information are used only for order processing, payment confirmation and delivery communication. Please do not submit unnecessary sensitive information.

No Cash on Delivery: Cash on Delivery is not available. Payment is accepted through Bank Transfer, JazzCash or Easypaisa.

Payment Before Processing: All orders, including customized products, are processed only after payment confirmation. Customization work requires payment first.

No Return / No Refund: All sales are final. No returns or refunds are available. Customers should confirm product selection, colour, size and customization requirements before payment.

Delivery: A fixed Rs. 250 delivery charge is automatically added to every cart/order when the subtotal is below Rs. 5000. Orders with a subtotal of Rs. 5000 or more receive FREE delivery.

Customization: Customized items are made according to the customer's confirmed requirements. Once payment and customization details are confirmed, changes/cancellation may not be possible.

Admin Contact: For services, payment confirmation, customization or order support, message 03167307274 or email seemabsajid407@gmail.com.
